protocol_recovery.prediction_scope: Measured base plans; conditional recovery cost/success not inferred

compatibility: Solver Config fields match the measured base plans. One format retry is an explicit unmeasured recovery overlay within the same caps; runtime hash audited separately. Cascades are not inferred from singles.

limitations: Local P2 candidate only. No new real-provider quality, cost, calibration, token savings or benchmark measurement.
Original v2 estimates are inherited only for unchanged base solver model/prompt/caps. Enabled preflight skip changes policy outcomes and has no measured success/expense estimates.

Checker defaults off; observe records diagnostics without changing model-facing messages or planning decisions, except bounded local wall time. Explicit skip is limited to exact supported public contracts and complete Missing before first send.

Post-tool diagnostics read original named public source paths as observed after an already paid tool action; they cannot skip or save the first model call. Failed/truncated tool output never supplies Missing.

Natural-language operations outside the explicit latest_sum grammar, undeclared derivations, nonfunctional/unknown chains and incomplete sources are unsupported/Unknown. Local time checks are cooperative between bounded parsing/regular-file I/O operations.
Historical P1 termination/deadline/admission changes remain reviewed here. Old control and P1 bundles/reviews are preserved and require their matching source snapshots.
Text applicability is limited to one full-sentence CSV operation chosen from two public train inputs. No general natural-language interpretation or classification.

128 public tasks inspected only for applicability after design freeze: 2 plans/Found, 126 Unknown, 0 Missing. No demonstrated savings on historical underdetermined tasks; holdout/original regression did not tune rules.
Additional known unmodeled fields/sources can downgrade natural-language nulls to Unknown; numeric/order failures cannot prove Missing.

New independent text fixtures exercise paraphrases, schema/path/entity renames, empty input, irrelevant nulls, explicit product/zero, ambiguity and limits; private expectations never enter interpreter.

Admission gate rejected paid P2 pilot: 24 fresh development tasks in 9 mechanism families, 4 plans only in deliberate positive controls, 0/20 outside controls. Two certified Missing controls, no false Missing/skip among 12 solvable fixtures. This is not an estimate on the competition distribution.
Independent SQLite references and two-world/interpretation ambiguity certificates are private-grader-only. Gate and public/private hashes were sealed before each offline comparison.
No real paired solver experiment, no score/cost/call savings or 15% expense criterion measured. Existing campaign collector was reviewed; paid preparation was not warranted after offline no-go.
JSON zero represented as floating 0.0 with an unknown other factor stays Unknown: parser may have underflowed a nonzero literal. Integer/string exact zero is safely derivable.

R1 wrapper import compatibility is verified only with local subprocesses and synthetic MockTransport responses, including the exact saved P3 response. No new API calls, measured score gain, cost/call saving, calibration or real quality revalidation.

The sole helper module is submit_answer, reserved in the isolated tool sys.modules. It exposes the existing functions and does not persist into nested independently launched interpreters or the controlling process. Python tooling remains container-dependent, not a new security sandbox.

Prompts, revision bounded-json-agent-v4 and all sixteen solver configurations remain unchanged. External contract documentation is not supplied to the model. Historical traces and previous bundles/reviews remain valid only for their original runtime snapshots.
Current source includes the prior reviewed cancellation/answer boundary/P2 changes; P2 defaults off. R1 changes no selection, model, cap, budget reserve, budget-tail plan or concurrency.
